LanguageData.Mugirl_Blindfold.description: A restraint designed to obstruct Mugirl's vision; sensory deprivation is said to heighten the victim's sensitivity (๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧. The blindfold features a proprietary locking mechanism requiring a [Rough Restraint Key] for release.
LanguageData.Mugirl_Blindfold.label: Mugirl Slave Blindfold
LanguageData.Mugirl_Earplugs.description: A fully enclosed restraint device designed to block Mugirl's hearing entirely. Once fitted, external sounds become virtually inaudible, plunging the victim into a silent, isolated environment. The earplugs feature a proprietary locking mechanism requiring a [Rough Restraint Key] for release.
LanguageData.Mugirl_Earplugs.label: Mugirl Slave Earplugs
LanguageData.Mugirl_Gagstick.description: A restraint designed to restrict the vocalisations of Mugirl, effectively preventing clear speech and permitting only indistinct whimpering sounds. The gagstick features a proprietary locking mechanism requiring a [Rough Restraint Key] for release.
LanguageData.Mugirl_Gagstick.label: Mugirl Slave Gagstick
